    Projective covers over finite-dimensional algebras #

    structure EFiniteCharacterizations.FGModuleCat.ProjectiveCover {R : Type u} [Ring R] (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    Type (u + 1)

    A projective cover is a right-minimal epimorphism from a finite projective.

    • source : FGModuleCat R

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FGModuleCat.nonempty_projectiveCover {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (M : FGModuleCat R) :
      Nonempty (ProjectiveCover M)

      Choosing a projective epimorphism of least ground dimension gives a cover, since the stable image of an endomorphism over its target is a projective summand still surjecting onto the target.
